architecture.placement_note: Use supplied door overlay rectangles without trimming or independently recentering frames. Collisions and interactions are integration suggestions, not implemented engine behavior.
architecture.fences_note: These are front-facing billboard modules. Directional layout and junction placement require scene review; do not mirror modules.

fence_placement.coordinate_convention: Local native pixel coordinates, x/y zero-based; all endpoint origins share local baseline y=31.

placement_recipe.general_rule: For n straight spans, place left end at (0,0), straight k at (32*(k+1),0) for k=0..n-1, and right end at (32*(n+1),0). Keep the common y=31 foot baseline. No overlap is needed for a connected run.
placement_recipe.remaining_visual_limit: The end upper rails are shifted down one pixel relative to the straight span; the lower rail matches exactly. A y translation cannot align both rail envelopes simultaneously. Keep y unchanged to preserve the lower rail and accept the small upper-edge jog for this billboard prop set; do not claim a perfectly seamless end join.

corner_and_gates.recommendation: Place corner and gate sprites as scene props using their visual posts, pivots and overlap. Review rail-to-post connections and collision in the scene. Do not auto-connect these cells by plain 32px adjacency or promise tile/autotile junction coverage.

ledge_placement.note: Discrete placed billboard prop. Plain 64 px adjacency leaves a gap; no continuous ledge-strip guarantee is supplied.

ground_edge_rules.rule: Use matching opposing edge-profile labels. One-pixel border strips are copied from generated donor tiles; interiors remain unchanged after reduction/palette mapping.
limitations: Angular corner shoulders and repeated fill motifs remain visible.
No direct dirt/cobble or pond/deep-water transition families are supplied.

presentation_review_status: Source-art and placement review; not a finished HD-2D scene.
camera_dependent_extensions: Additional building side/roof/depth surfaces require the actual selected camera and visible-surface need. No blanket isometric conversion.
